source: due2-native: a policy that declares a profile due2 has no module for
notes: The policy is valid ODRL 2.2: it uses only odrl: terms and declares its profile (IM 2.1). due2 cannot read the profile, so it cannot tell what the profile declares. Here the policy states no odrl:conflict, so with no profile the default is invalid (IM 2.10), but the profile may declare prohibit, and the two give different verdicts when both rules apply. IM 3.2 requires a processor that does not recognise a profile to stop.

expected_rejection.why: The policy declares <http://example.com/profiles/geo>, which has no due2 module, so due2 cannot read what it declares (IM 3.2, decisions/0033 #2). W1 rejects the policy in stage 1.
